integrity: Every statement is supported by explicit deterministic finite enumeration and a mathematical Lefschetz/induction argument in the included proof. No independent validation or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: This is the natural 720-element S6 action on reduced rational homology of a single scale-four intrinsic Cech complex; the nonequivariant wedge was previously published. Induction is over C, not an integral lattice identification. Neither full 1440-element symmetry nor equivariant homotopy is addressed; an unindexed equivalent calculation remains possible.
title: The natural \(S_6\)-character of the scale-four Tutte–Coxeter Čech nerve is induced from \(C_5\)
